messages:
incident-bot: Pager: auth-service anomalies detected in prod - elevated 401s across multiple clients. severity=high. on-call: @maya. alert: https://alerts.redwood/alert/2060002468 :alarm_clock:
maya: On it. looking at graphs and logs now. which query fired?
oliver: Alert query: sum(rate(auth_request_errors[1m])) by (error_type) > 2000. Spike 12:03-12:08 UTC. Endpoint mostly /api/v1/sessions/validate. Logs show repeated 'kid not found' + 'invalid signature' messages.
jordan: That points at JWKS mismatch or key rotation gone wrong. I'm pulling KMS and JWKS logs. Also seeing odd S3 GETs to backups/log-archive-2026 from a foreign IP, flagging possible leaked logs.
lia: Any customer impact yet? which tenants?
samir: Early view: enterprise-acme, beta-eval, internal-dev have uptick in 5xx/401. Others mostly unaffected. If tokens are compromised, we may need broad rotation -> SEV1 potential.
maya: For now SEV2. @jordan confirm if JWKS rotation failed. @oliver snapshot auth pods and hold deploys. I'll page Sec.
jordan: KMS shows rotation job for service key svc-auth-key started ~2h ago and failed with 500 from rotation-service. JWKS endpoint returned an orphaned 'kid' entry while new key not promoted -> clients saw unknown kid. Possible partial rotation left old keys invalid. Also noticed s3 access to /backups/logs/ with some auth logs.
oliver: Pulling runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/auth-key-rotation. I recommend soft fallback: point auth-service to cached JWKS to stop churn. Avoid killing pods.
maya: Agreed, don't kill all pods. @samir can you prepare the env patch to point to cached jwks?
samir: Patch ready: set AUTH_JWKS_URL to https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-cached/jwks.json via k8s secret. Command: `kubectl set env deploy/auth-service AUTH_JWKS_URL=https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-cached/jwks.json -n prod` -> will reduce kid lookups to failing rotation service.
jordan: I'll rotate the suspect keys immediately. Preparing script: `/scripts/rotate_service_keys --filter=kid=orphan-2026 --yes` (will rotate and update JWKS). Need approval to run emergency rotate.
maya: Approved. Jordan, proceed. @sec-bot open incident ticket and notify legal/privacy.
sec-bot: Created INC-2026-4482. Notifying #legal and #privacy. Adding initial severity=SEV2, classification=auth+potential-data-exposure.
helena: I can draft customer notice for affected tenants. Lia, want to review?
lia: Yes send draft to #customer-success-drafts. Keep it concise: what happened, who affected, mitigations, and next steps. Avoid technical over-share.
jordan: Rotation in progress. Rotated keys: orphan-2026 -> replaced by rotated-2026-{a,b,c}. Updating JWKS now. Audit shows a GET to cached JWKS from IP 203.0.113.77 ~ 11:59 UTC. Blocking IP at edge.
oliver: Applied temporary WAF rule blocking 203.0.113.77 (waf-rule-id: waf-773). Also disabled public access on s3 backup-logs-2026: `aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket backup-logs-2026 --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true`
maya: Error rate dropping: from ~8k 401/min to ~420 after fallback + rotation. Monitoring for regressions.
samir: Revoking long-lived refresh tokens for the three impacted tenants as precaution: `POST /admin/v1/sessions/revoke?filter=tenant:enterprise-acme,beta-eval,internal-dev`. This will force reauth and invalidate potentially leaked tokens.
jordan: KMS team: recommend rotating backing CMK and re-encrypting at rest for artifacts touched. I'll coordinate with infra. Also collecting S3 access logs for exfil analysis.
maya: Next actions: 1) Confirm no further 'kid not found' errors; 2) Complete key rotation and promote stable JWKS; 3) Finish S3 access audit and scope any exfil; 4) Send targeted customer notices; 5) Prep postmortem. Handing off to next on-call at 14:00 UTC -> @oliver take lead.
oliver: Taking over. Will run through runbook checklist, update INC-2026-4482, and run sanity checks (smoke auth flows, token issuance).
helena: Draft customer message uploaded. Lia please approve for send to affected account contacts.
lia: Approved. Send at T+2h unless more findings.
maya: Logging final note here before handoff: we avoided killing pods, used JWKS fallback + emergency key rotation + WAF block + s3 public block. Good containment for now. Will follow up with a full timeline and RCA. :white_check_mark:
oliver: Noted. Adding timeline to ticket and tagging @eng-manager for postmortem.
sec-bot: Reminder: collect forensic snapshots (avoid writes), store in secure bucket INC-2026-4482-evidence.
jordan: Forensics captured. Starting indicators of compromise list.
maya: Thanks everyone. Thread will stay open for updates.
